rawContent: Shut It Down is having our 4 year anniversary action this Monday, February 4th! Join us at 7 PM at Grand Central Terminal as we remember #AmadouDiallo, a Black man murdered by the NYPD on that day in 1999. #PeoplesMonday #BlackLivesMatter #FTP https://t.co/cAHLOzhhkw https://t.co/VGYBanAaxa

Our next #PeoplesMonday will honor #LanekiaBrown, a 37 year old pregnant Black woman who died in custody in December 2018. Join us this Monday, February 11th at 7 PM in front of Brooklyn Borough Hall! #BlackLivesMatter #FTP https://t.co/QlOQD0qtWC https://t.co/OP8vL0qkTo

Our next #PeoplesMonday will honor 5 victims of 5 different US presidents, from Washington to Trump. Join us this Monday, February 18th at 7 PM at Cooper Square! #BlackLivesMatter #FTP https://t.co/smGaP7ANIt https://t.co/WrLU80Knze

Our next #PeoplesMonday will honor #RonaldSpear, a Black man killed by corrections officers while awaiting trial at Rikers Island. Join us this Monday, March 4th, at 7 PM at the Adam Clayton Powell Jr State Office Building in Harlem! #BlackLivesMatter #FTP https://t.co/gH8YiLVSo9 https://t.co/DvLJy93FB9
